Title: MB8+ Ribeye dissolved on the palate at 54°C — world class butchery
Review Content: Ordered the 900g O'Connor dry-aged bone-in ribeye along with a full packer Wagyu brisket for my 40th. Reverse-seared the steak on ironbark coals to an internal temp of 54°C. The marbling and fat render was equivalent to what I paid $240 for at Firedoor last month. Packaging arrived sub-zero in custom wool insulation.

Title: Pure Texas mahogany bark on my offset smoker. Supermarkets can't touch this.
Review Content: Australian pitmasters know the pain of buying supermarket briskets with zero deckle fat. The 5.8kg Full Packer Angus Brisket from The Meat Agent had a uniform 6mm fat cap and thick flat end. Smoked over pecan wood for 14 hours at 110°C. Jiggled like gelatin at 94°C internal. Will never buy competition meat anywhere else.

Title: Feeds our family of five for 3 weeks — $423 minimum order pays for itself
Review Content: With three teenage boys doing row and footy, our grocery bill was out of control at Coles. We pooled our order to hit the $423 threshold and got 6kg of pure grass-fed beef mince, 20 thick wagyu burgers, 4kg of thin snags, and diced chuck for winter casseroles. The meat has zero watery runoff in the pan. Real farm taste.
Purchased Product: The Essential Family Bulk Meat Box (18kg)

Title: 48-hr ice gel blocks arrived rock solid in 38°C Queensland heat
Review Content: Living regional in the Scenic Rim, cold-chain couriers often disappoint. The thermal sealed box arrived via refrigerated courier, and the internal meat probed at 1.8°C. Vacuum sealing was pristine with zero blown bags. Local Queensland family business done right.

Title: Outstanding scotch fillets, courier window was delayed by 2 hours
Review Content: The scotch fillet marble score 5 was exceptionally tender and the grass-fed fat cap gave that nutty, deep beef flavour you only get from southern Victorian pastures. Giving 4 stars only because StarTrack refrigerated was 2 hours outside their estimated SMS delivery window, though temperature inside was still ice-cold.
Company Reply: The Master Butcher & Management: G'day Lachlan, thank you for the honest review. We are delighted the scotch fillets hit the mark on flavour and marbling. We have raised the transit timing delay with our refrigerated cold-chain dispatch team in Western Sydney to tighten courier window accuracy. We appreciate your support!

Title: Pasture-raised lamb cutlets with clean bone trim — zero gamey odour
Review Content: Finding pasture-raised southern lamb cutlets in WA with a proper French trim is rare. Cooked over charcoal with rosemary and garlic. The sweetness of the fat was sublime. Took advantage of the 10% crypto discount paying with Bitcoin. Process was instant and saved me over $50 AUD.

Title: Authentic Bistecca alla Fiorentina in Melbourne
Review Content: As someone who grew up in Tuscany, I am fiercely critical of T-bones sold in Australia. The Meat Agent's 1.2kg Fiorentina had the exact height (3 fingers thick) and proper balance between tenderloin and striploin. Salted 24 hours ahead, cooked high heat, sliced with Tuscan EVOO and lemon. Bravissimi!

Title: Incredible asado flanken ribs, but brisket needed a little extra trimming
Review Content: The cross-cut asado ribs were packed with marbling and smoked in 4 hours into butter. The brisket point was juicy, but had a slight unevenness on one corner that required 100g of trim. Otherwise, the best supplier pricing in Australia for bulk orders.
Purchased Product: Beef Asado Short Ribs & Angus Brisket Box
Company Reply: The Master Butcher & Management: Appreciate your feedback, Nathaniel. As competition pitmasters ourselves, we inspect every packer brisket closely. We will ensure our boning room trims the flat edges even more uniformly on future batches. Glad the asado ribs delivered that rich melt!

Title: 10-Pack Lean Rumps are an absolute lifesaver for bodybuilding prep
Review Content: I weigh out 220g cooked beef daily. The 10-pack 2.5kg rump box comes portioned and vacuum sealed separately. Throws straight into my freezer and defrosts in 15 minutes in cold water. Zero grizzle, high protein, lean grass-fed fuel.

Title: Even delivered to Tasmania in perfect condition
Review Content: Was sceptical about ordering across Bass Strait to Hobart. Arrived within 48 hours via specialized thermal courier. The Angus burger patties cooked smash-style on my cast iron were restaurant standard. Juicy, seasoned right, no filler.
Purchased Product: Tasmanian Special Gourmet Patty & Steak Combo

Title: Superb meat quality, but the $423 minimum order is high for singles
Review Content: The quality of the beef cheeks and ribeyes is genuinely 5 stars—better than any local boutique butcher. However, living alone, hitting the $423 minimum order threshold required me to clear out half my chest freezer. Great for big families or BBQ parties, but tough for one person unless you split with mates.
Purchased Product: Slow-Braised Beef Cheeks & Eye Fillet Box
Company Reply: The Master Butcher & Management: Thanks for the feedback Jason. The $423 minimum order is deliberate—it allows us to bypass high retail storefront margins, provide direct wholesale pricing from farm suppliers, and pack commercial-grade sub-zero thermal insulation without charging inflated handling fees. Many of our customers team up with neighbours or gym mates for collective bulk orders!

Title: 12-hour braised beef cheeks in red wine — gelatinous perfection
Review Content: Trimmed beef cheeks are usually a nightmare to clean yourself. The Heritage Meat Co's cheeks arrived 100% silverskin-trimmed and portioned. Braised for 5 hours with pinot noir and bone stock. Literally cut with a dessert spoon.

Title: Wagyu Shabu Shabu & Yakiniku cut with microscopic precision
Review Content: We hosted an 8-person Japanese hot pot night. The Wagyu BMS 7 brisket and rib-cap slices were paper-thin, perfectly inter-layered with butcher parchment so nothing stuck together. Melted in the dashi broth within 4 seconds.

Title: Top tier St. Louis Pork Ribs, slight delay on WhatsApp order confirmation
Review Content: The pork ribs had immense meat coverage on the bone with zero shiners. Smoked competition style 3-2-1 with cherry glaze. Ordered through the WhatsApp checkout link; took about 25 minutes for the dispatch coordinator to confirm payment receipt, but after that shipment was silky smooth.
Purchased Product: St. Louis Competition Pork Ribs (4 racks)
Company Reply: The Master Butcher & Management: Cheers Gareth! We pride ourselves on the meat-to-bone ratio of our female pork racks. We have expanded our direct WhatsApp concierge desk hours so orders are confirmed in under 5 minutes during peak evening hours.

Title: Wholesale direct pricing beat my local butcher by $18/kg on Scotch Fillets
Review Content: Did the math before purchasing. My local butcher wanted $68/kg for grass-fed scotch fillet. The Meat Agent was $48/kg in bulk cryovac, and the marbling was visibly superior. Free delivery kicked in over our $2,000 corporate Christmas party order.

Title: Heritage pork belly with crackling that blistered like glass
Review Content: Scored, salted, and left uncovered overnight in the fridge as recommended in their recipe blog. Roasted at 240°C for 25 mins then down to 160°C. The crackle was uniform and snap-crisp, fat layer succulent without being greasy.

Title: Tropical delivery in 35C monsoon humidity - held thermal integrity
Review Content: Most southern butcheries won't even quote freight to Darwin. The Meat Agent's specialized cold-chain took 3 days via air express, internal meat temp was 2.4°C on arrival. One box corner had minor condensation scuffing, but vacuum seals intact.
Company Reply: The Master Butcher & Management: Peter, delivering sub-zero to the Top End in the wet season is our badge of honour! We use double-thick expanded poly liner + dry ice bricks for NT air shipments. Great to have you as part of our national network.

Title: Real hand-linked butcher snags, zero meal filler or grain bloat
Review Content: Our kids are allergic to gluten and cheap fillers in supermarket sausages. These are pure beef, salt, pepper, and natural hog casings. The snap when you bite into them off the barbecue is nostalgic. Top tier.

Title: Wagyu Tomahawk MB9 was the undisputed centerpiece of our dinner
Review Content: 1.6kg of sheer Australian agricultural perfection. Reverse-seared with herb compound butter basting. Deep ruby color, nutty buttery fat, and the bone was cleanly scraped. Will be reordering for New Year's Eve.

Title: Prime cuts are stellar, but packaging ice blocks are heavy to dispose of
Review Content: The dry aged T-bones and eye fillets were extraordinary in flavour and tenderness. My only gripe is the size of the frozen gel packs—there were six large heavy ice bricks in the box which took up room in my bin. Understand it's needed for the 48hr thermal guarantee though.
Purchased Product: Dry-Aged T-Bone & Eye Fillet Duo Pack
Company Reply: The Master Butcher & Management: G'day Craig! The non-toxic gel inside our thermal blocks is 100% water-soluble and can be cut open and poured down the sink (or used to water garden plants as a soil conditioner!), and the outer LDPE sleeve is soft-plastic recyclable. We are also testing wool-pack liners for upcoming regional runs. Enjoy those T-bones!

Title: Kangaroo fillets and lean wild game cuts are second to none
Review Content: Cooked the wild kangaroo fillets medium-rare on a piping hot plancha with bush pepper. Tender as eye fillet with that rich native Australian game depth. Fantastic lean protein source for athletic recovery.

Title: PayID checkout was smooth and instant, received delivery SMS next morning
Review Content: Transferred via Osko/PayID at 9pm on Tuesday. Automated confirmation came through immediately and courier track link was live by 8:30am Wednesday. Arrived in Adelaide by Thursday lunch. Premium service from Queensland.

Title: Dino Beef Ribs on the Traeger — pure crowd pleaser
Review Content: The 3-bone English plate ribs had nearly 4 inches of meat before shrinking back on the bone. Salt, coarse pepper, and post oak. The smoke ring was 1cm deep. Feeds 6 hungry adults easily. Great communication on WhatsApp.

Title: Exceptional mince and chicken breast combo, box arrived late afternoon
Review Content: The chicken breast is completely clean—no yellow fat or water pumping like in the supermarket tubs. The 2kg mince browned in the pan with zero grey water. Courier arrived at 4:45pm which was later than expected, but packaging was frosty cold.
Purchased Product: Lean Chicken Breast & Beef Mince Prep Box (10kg)
Company Reply: The Master Butcher & Management: Thanks Kylie! We refuse to use chlorine-washed or moisture-injected poultry. Our chicken is 100% free-range air-chilled, which is why it sears golden instead of steaming. We'll continue working with Victorian regional dispatch for earlier delivery routes.

Title: Proud to support our local Ipswich meat direct operation
Review Content: Living in Ipswich, I know the facility on Brisbane St. These guys supply some of the finest kitchens in South East Queensland and opening direct-to-consumer online ordering with farm gate pricing is a game-changer. 5 stars all day long.
Purchased Product: The Local Pitmaster Primal Feast Box
